# Refinix Solutions

> Refinix Solutions is a digital development and growth company providing web development, custom software, app development, SEO, digital marketing and social media services for businesses.

Refinix Solutions helps businesses build useful digital products and improve their online presence through technology, design and digital growth services.

The company focuses on practical solutions rather than unnecessary technical complexity.

## Company

- [Our Process](https://refinix.in/process): How Refinix approaches strategy, design, development, launch and improvement.
- [Our Work](https://refinix.in/work): Selected projects and digital work created by Refinix Solutions.
- [Contact Refinix Solutions](https://refinix.in/contact): Contact and project enquiry information.

## Services

- [All Services](https://refinix.in/services): Overview of Refinix Solutions' digital services.
- [Web Development](https://refinix.in/services/web-development-service): Business websites and digital experiences designed around usability, performance, SEO foundations and conversion.
